en: Sepia-toned historic postcard view of a European city square labeled "Aussig. Franz Josefs-Platz." The image shows a large landscaped park with many trees, paths, and a central green area. Surrounding the park are ornate multi-story 19th‑century buildings with elaborate facades and mansard roofs. In the foreground there is a utility pole with multiple insulators and visible tram tracks along the street to the right. Hills or low mountains appear in the distant background.
